title: Hold an electrical contractor licence
what: Carry on business as an electrical contractor only as authorised by an electrical contractor's licence.

sources.title: Electricity (Licensing) Regulations 1991 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: a person who carries on business as an electrical contractor, or advertises, or otherwise holds out or implies, that the person is carrying on business as an electrical contractor, commits an offence unless the person is authorised by an electrical contractor's licence to so carry on business
